name: Working with the AI while it works
vision_statement: A person works with the AI while it works: they see what it does and which structure it serves, and can stop, steer and approve, on any surface and with any harness.
opportunities: The terminal, a separate frontend and the view of how ESOI is involved each improve on their own measure without changing the contract between a harness and a surface, so a new surface or a better way to show sub-agents on solutions never needs a new harness adapter.
solution_coherence: AI Session Experience keeps one contract: typed events going out of a run and typed controls going back, with the adapters that make any harness satisfy it. Structure In View reads the events and the ESOI records and shows which solutions the AI is working on, which sub-agent is on which, and, only when a person opens a solution, its fields and connections. Frontend Interface carries the events, the controls, the run facts and that structure as plain data for a separate web or mobile frontend. Terminal Experience is the reference surface: it draws the run and the structure as lines, reads keys and is the interactive entry.
